## Climate Trends in Spain and Europe

**Professional project · PKF Attest · Power BI · Data analysis**

### Research question

How have temperature and precipitation patterns evolved
across Spain and Europe?

### My contribution

Carried out the end-to-end analysis, from source data
through to visual reporting and short and long report
formats for clients.

The report was subsequently published by PKF Attest.

### Skills demonstrated

- Data preparation and structuring.
- Analysis of geographical and temporal patterns.
- Power BI visualisation.
- Interpretation and communication of findings.
- Delivery of an analytical project from data to reports.

## Gamification & Commercial Success in Educational Math Apps

**Mathematics bachelor's thesis · R · Statistical modelling**

### Research question

Which gamification features are associated with downloads
of educational mathematics apps?

### My contribution

Analysed a stratified sample of 200 apps drawn from a cleaned
population of 4,218 educational mathematics apps.

Used multiple linear regression with HC3 robust standard
errors, diagnostic checks and sensitivity analyses to examine
associations between app features and downloads.

### Skills demonstrated

- Data cleaning and sampling.
- Statistical modelling in R.
- Model diagnostics and robustness assessment.
- Interpretation of observational evidence.
- Reproducible analytical documentation.

[Read the case study](gamification.qmd) ·
[Explore the code](https://github.com/lauraiglesiasgr/gamification-math-apps-analysis/tree/main/R) ·
[Read the thesis](https://github.com/lauraiglesiasgr/gamification-math-apps-analysis/blob/main/report/TFG_Iglesias_Garcia.pdf)

## Mathematical Flexibility in Primary Education

**Primary Education bachelor's thesis · Mixed methods · JASP**

### Research question

What mathematical strategies become visible during fraction
games, and how do written assessment scores differ before
and after the sequence?

### My contribution

Designed three games, assessment instruments and a five-session
classroom study.

Combined written assessments, structured observation and
qualitative records for a follow-up sample of 15 participants
selected within a class of 22.

### Skills demonstrated

- Research and instrument design.
- Stratified sampling and structured data collection.
- Descriptive statistics and paired non-parametric testing.
- Quantitative and qualitative interpretation.
- Critical evaluation of measurement and study limitations.

The portfolio case study is under review before public release.
